request.spec: Let me write notes on a project. Show the newest one first.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read CLAUDE.md — it states the working rules, the project layout, and the data-testid
conventions. Follow it.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
Let me write notes on a project. Show the newest one first.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, and any audit records it
expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as you work;
iterate until it passes. Implement the full-stack change (database migration + OfficeFloor
server + front-end). Do NOT edit the pinned scaffolding (bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop,
bin/e2e, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md) or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
The change is complete and the acceptance test passes. Here's a summary of the full-stack change I implemented for **"Let me write notes on a project. Show the newest one first."**

## Database (Flyway)
- `V18__notes.sql` — a new `notes` table with a generic target (`target_type` + `target_id`), `text`, and `created_at` (`TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE`), plus an index on `(target_type, target_id, created_at DESC)` for the newest-first lookup.

## Server (OfficeFloor on Spring Boot)
- `Note` entity, `NoteRepository` (`findByTargetTypeAndTargetIdOrderByCreatedAtDescIdDesc` — newest first, id as stable tie-break), `NoteView`, `NoteForm`.
- `ListNotes` → `GET /api/notes?targetType=&targetId=` and `CreateNote` → `POST /api/notes` (stamps `createdAt` server-side on write), each wired by a new YAML under `rest/api/`.
- `TestSupportController`: seeds `notes` from the fixture (with explicit ids and `at`), truncates `notes` on reset, and bumps the H2 identity past the seeded ids so an API-created note gets a fresh id instead of colliding.

## Front-end (additive)
- `features/projects/notesApi.ts` — the `Note` type, query key `['notes', 'project', id]`, and the list/create calls.
- `features/projects/notes.slot.tsx` — one new panel filling the existing `project.detail` region: a newest-first list (`note-row-<id>` / `note-text`, rendered in server order) above an add form (`note-form-text` / `note-form-submit`). Reads via `useQuery`, writes via `useMutation` + `invalidateQueries` on the shared key.

The data-testid anchors match the spec exactly (`note-row-`, `note-text`, `note-form-text`, `note-form-submit`), and `bin/e2e` passes.

One thing worth flagging: I discovered that H2's `GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY` doesn't advance the sequence when the seed inserts explicit ids, so the first API-created note was colliding on id 1 — I handle that in the notes seed. This same latent issue would affect any other table where a test seeds explicit ids and then creates through the API; I only addressed it for `notes` to keep the change local.
